title: record blocks bound to a dataSource that yields no row draw an authored empty state, not the renderer's raw placeholder (ruling B on cloud#2774)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24266 (the spec half, domain:spec first — recorded by the triage seat)

Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 4, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's ruling Q2 B on objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 (batch #362 item 5, 「其他同意」; the ruling record is that card's `Ruled:` line) under the standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」. ⛔ Not a claim. Filing gate ①: a measured gap with a named consumer.

## What is measured (objectui `origin/main` `1e6d83bc4895`, cloud dev's R7)
- A `record:details` / `record:highlights` / `record:quick_actions` block bound through a per-element `dataSource` (objectui#12294) that yields no row draws the renderer's own 「record not found」 or a dashed 「no actions configured」; there is no authored empty state. An organisation with no production environment would see the raw placeholder on the ruled environments page.

## Scope
1. The four record blocks accept an authored empty state (the spec's existing empty-state shape where one exists; otherwise the lane declares `Clause-②` for one key) and draw it when the bound source yields no row.
2. The default stays the loud renderer text, never a blank.

## Done when
- A test: a bound `record:details` with no row draws the authored empty state; without one it draws the loud default.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2774, #2916; objectui#12294.
